theorem QOU.Hecke.ClosedForm.trace_interface_bond {R : Type u} [Field R] {n : ℕ} {q : R} {A : Type u} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [HA : HeckeAlgebra R n q A] [MT : MarkovTrace n q A] (s : R) (hz : MarkovTrace.z_param n q A = markovZ s) (i : Generator n) (k : InterfaceKind) :
(MarkovTrace.trace n q) (HeckeAlgebra.embed q i + bondD s k • 1) = interfaceFactor s k

closedFormTauM s tauP tauN Z N (canonicalInterfaceKinds Z N) = tauP ^ Z * tauN ^ N * (fPP s ^ (Z - 1) * fNN s ^ (N - 1) * fPN s)

theorem QOU.Hecke.ClosedForm.fPP_mul_fNN {R : Type u} [Field R] (s : R) :

theorem QOU.Hecke.ClosedForm.flavorDelta_one {R : Type u} [Field R] :

theorem QOU.Hecke.ClosedForm.flavorDelta_eq_hbar_form {R : Type u} [Field R] (s : R) (hs : s ≠ 0) :

theorem QOU.Hecke.ClosedForm.strictAvg_bar_invariant {R : Type u} [Field R] (s : R) (hs : s ≠ 0) (h4 : s ^ 4 + 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : 2 ≠ 0) :
